title: Image-backend adapter registry (capability image-platform)
description: Single index for the /image pluggable adapter layer (--use=<adapter>). SPLIT registry: a built adapter (status=installed) carries a `generator` script path; a `registered-not-built` stub carries none. Structural shape only; supports[] ⊆ UNIVERSAL_PARAMS, installed⇒generator-on-disk, and preset_of⇒target-exists are enforced by scripts/cross-tier/validate-image-adapters.cjs.

id.description: Unique adapter slug; the value passed to --use=<id>.

status.description: installed = a real generator wired (file-existence required). registered-not-built = stub: documents intent + native param surface, no generator yet.

generator.description: repo-relative path to the generator script. Required (validator) when status=installed; absent for stubs.

skill.description: repo-relative path to the adapter SKILL.md folder.

preset_of.description: If set, this id is a PRESET alias of another adapter; preset_flags are applied on top.

preset_flags.description: Flags layered on when this preset is used (e.g. {enhance:true, tier:high}).

supports.description: Universal param flags this adapter honors natively. Must be ⊆ UNIVERSAL_PARAMS.

supports_stretch.description: Params the adapter COULD support via extra work (e.g. a 2nd endpoint) but does NOT in v0.1 → WARN-as-unsupported until built. Must be ⊆ UNIVERSAL_PARAMS.

unsupported_warn.description: Params with no mapping on this backend → WARN (never silent-drop). Must be ⊆ UNIVERSAL_PARAMS.

env.description: env var holding the key (null = no key / 3rd-party bridge).
